mentions.name: Vibe
mentions.description: A Winamp-like music player for macOS. The developer resumed work on it after a multi-year hiatus and is currently adding localization along with other long-planned features.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Vibe, my Winamp-like MacOS music player.

I use it every day, but had stopped dev on it a few years ago. Fable has gotten me excited to take it off the shelf and add a bunch of features I've been wanting for a while. Working on localization now.
mentions.author: cmicali
